tickets.title: Review rental condo protection
tickets.text: Review the Bend rental condo's landlord, tenant, liability, property loss, and loss-of-rent exposures to ensure adequate coverage, as these were not part of the prior household insurance review.
tickets.evidence: For the rental condo protection review, the Bend rental condo adds landlord, tenant, liability, property loss, and loss-of-rent exposures that were not part of the prior household insurance review.

tickets.title: Compare employer benefits with private coverage
tickets.text: Compare Moonbadger Robotics supplemental life, disability, and beneficiary settings with Arlo's private coverage before the benefits election portal closes.
tickets.evidence: Moonbadger Robotics opened a benefits election window tied to Arlo’s promotion, and the supplemental life, disability, and beneficiary settings need comparison with the private coverage before the portal closes. That comparison is needed by March 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain current life insurance beneficiary evidence
tickets.text: Obtain current carrier evidence from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance to resolve the beneficiary arrangement discrepancy between the portal and the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file before the protection review can be finalized.
tickets.evidence: the Velvet Acorn Life Insurance portal shows a different beneficiary arrangement than the beneficiary summary retained in the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file, so current carrier evidence is needed before the protection review can be finalized. That evidence is needed by March 12, 2024.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Collect the estate planning documents for Arlo and Lena Copperwisp, including trust funding evidence and any documents that reflect the current household and insurance beneficiary structure. The advisory binder lacks trust funding evidence and includes fiduciary role information that may not reflect the current household.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: For estate planning document collection, the advisory review found that the estate binder lacks trust funding evidence and includes fiduciary role information that may not reflect the current household and insurance beneficiary structure.
